focus: Measurement trustworthiness: label provenance, corpus survival, record trail, metric sensitivity

label: Labels are documented operator-delegated model reads: two blind drafters agreed on every shared natural label, one Opus arbiter settled boundaries with spot-checks; risk and mitigation are recorded, but 035 spec:49 still says no model writes a label.

The single natural miss r50 is the arbiter's close call N51 (CLAUDE.md commands block); with only 5 natural positives, one row is 20% of that class, so class-split and sensitivity reporting are required.
